slides.headline: He was born in Moradabad. Now he runs Apple's entire global operation.
Sabih Khan became Apple's Chief Operating Officer, succeeding longtime COO Jeff Williams
slides.body: Born in 1966 in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, he joined Apple in 1995 after working at GE Plastics, becoming Senior Vice President of Operations in 2019 before the COO promotion.

slides.headline: He oversees Apple's worldwide operations, global supply chain, environmental and social initiatives, and AppleCare.
slides.body: Tim Cook called him 'a brilliant strategist' and one of the central architects of Apple's supply chain - the system that builds and moves hundreds of millions of devices a year.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when a Moradabad childhood becomes the foundation for running the world's most valuable supply chain.
slides.body: Khan's three-decade climb from engineer to COO is a reminder that operational excellence, not just software, is where Indian-origin leaders are now setting the global standard.
